category_title: Elementary students with ASD and language delay who generalize virtual experiences to real-world social interactions
scenario_title: Auditory Sensitivity and Attention Loss During Question-Based Learning
minimal_context: The student is answering a series of question-based learning items in a virtual zoo environment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start the virtual zoo lesson. Please answer the 12 questions on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Answers a few questions, then looks away from the screen, distracted by the kids walking outside the classroom.) How many questions are left?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep going. Listen to the audio description for the next question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Listens to the long aural feedback but becomes easily distracted by the extra information, losing attention to the learning task.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look back at the screen. We are on question number seven now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hears the peak sounds of the whale in the virtual zoo and reacts very sensitively to the sound, completely losing attention to the surroundings after having answered 6 questions.)
